capabilities: Assign a template note to any Base view layout
Override Base new-item creation buttons and commands to use the template
Substitute title, date, and time variables in template bodies and frontmatter
Merge template frontmatter with view filter and Kanban column properties
Resolve target folders from Base filters or vault defaults
disambiguation: Not a general templating plugin; templates only apply to items created from Base views.
extras: Requires Obsidian v1.10.0 or later with the core Bases plugin enabled; configuration is stored per view inside .base files rather than in a plugin settings tab.
intentEvidence: Configure template notes for Obsidian Base views and automatically populate newly created items
problem: Obsidian's core Bases creates new items as blank notes, with no way to apply a template note or merge view filter values into frontmatter.
summary: Template configurator for Obsidian Bases views that populates newly created items with rendered template bodies, variables, and merged frontmatter.
